placementMutants.note: Added after the placement rule was changed to anchor the drawn feet (commit dc750d0). Same protocol: applied to the working tree after the checked state was committed, measured, reverted with `git checkout -- src/DungeonFortress.Presentation/CameraView.cs`, and the restored tree re-run green at 492 passed. The scale mutants above are untouched.

mutants.name: the anchor forgets which part of the canvas the feet are on
mutants.change: top = feet - size * SpriteSupportFraction -> top = feet - size
mutants.why: It stands the canvas's bottom edge on the foot line instead of standing the drawn feet there — the mutation a careless simplification would actually produce, since dropping the fraction reads as harmless. It is NOT the rule the first round of Issue #77 confused with this one: that rule stands the canvas's bottom edge on the previous bottom edge (top = centre + sizeBefore/2 - size, reaching 43.636364 above centre), while this mutant reaches 45.151515. The two are 1.515152 px apart. Corrected 2026-08-02 by the coordinator after the confirming round of the independent review of PR #176 measured both; the first wording repeated exactly the confusion this round was called to undo.
mutants.result: FAILED: 8 of 492 — CameraViewTests.The_drawn_feet_do_not_move_when_the_body_grows (the feet rise by 2.575758 px instead of staying still: size * (1 - 92/96) at tile 40), CameraViewTests.Anchoring_the_drawn_feet_reaches_a_pixel_lower_than_anchoring_the_canvas (the body reaches 45.151515 above centre instead of 42.575758; 43.636364 is the canvas-anchored rule, which this mutant does not produce), RoomBorderDepthTests.No_stroke_above_the_depth_pass_lands_on_a_body_that_is_visible at all three tile sizes (the 2 quarters@19,2 crossings come back), and RoomBorderDepthTests.No_body_anywhere_can_reach_a_stroke_the_wall_in_front_does_not_cover at all three.

mutants.name: the ground moves with the body
mutants.change: ReferenceGoblinDrawSize * WorldVisualScale * (fraction - 0.5) -> the same times BodyVisualScale
mutants.why: The subtle wrong version: the foot line stays a foot line, but starts scaling with the owner's choice of body size — which puts the feet back exactly where the centred square had them, 28.33 px below the render centre. If only «the sprite stands on the foot line» were pinned and not «the foot line does not move», this would pass.
mutants.result: FAILED: 2 of 492 — the two tests that measure where the feet end up. The Issue #156 sweep stays green, because sinking the feet does not raise the head, which is the point of keeping both kinds of check.
